s01: Hello, my friend! (pause) Last week, we retold the story of the Rooster and the Little Bird. (pause) The rooster was kind and shared. (pause) Today, we name things at home. (pause) And we learn kind words!
room: First, let us look around my house. (pause) This is my bedroom. (pause) Listen to three words. (pause) Tap each picture and say it with me!
room-1: Bed. (pause) We sleep on a bed.
room-2: Pillow. (pause) My head rests on a soft pillow.
room-3: Blanket. (pause) A blanket keeps me warm.
school: Bed, pillow, blanket. Now let us find my school things. (pause) Here are my school things. (pause) Tap each one. (pause) Say the word!
school-2: Bag. (pause) My bag carries my things.
school-3: Pencil. (pause) I write with a pencil.
kitchen: Book, bag, pencil. Now let us go to the kitchen. (pause) It is time to eat! (pause) Tap each thing on the table. (pause) Say it with me!
kitchen-1: Plate. (pause) My rice is on the plate.
kitchen-2: Spoon. (pause) I eat with a spoon.
find: You know nine things at home! Let us play a game. (pause) Listen carefully. (pause) I say a word. (pause) You tap the picture.
find-q1: Where is the spoon? Tap it!
find-q2: Where is the pillow? Tap it!
find-q3: Where is the book? Tap it!
please: Sometimes we need a spoon, a book or some water. How do we ask? (pause) Here is a magic word. (pause) Please! (pause) We say please when we ask for something. (pause) Say: Please pass the spoon.
ask: Please is a magic word. Let us use it with our home words. (pause) Here are kind ways to ask. (pause) Tap a line and say it with me. (pause) Use a soft voice!
ask-1: May I please borrow your book?
ask-3: May I have a glass of water, please?
ask-4: Can you please help me carry my bag?
s1: You can ask nicely. Let us see if Bunso can! (pause) Story time! (pause) Our story is called, Bunso Asks Nicely. (pause) First, Tala reads her new book. (pause) Bunso sees it. (pause) He wants to read it too!
s2: What does Bunso do? (pause) Next, Bunso grabs the book! (pause) Give me that, he says. (pause) Oh no! (pause) Tala is sad.
feel: Oh no! Let us stop and think. (pause) Bunso grabbed the book. (pause) How does Tala feel?
feel-q1-yes: Yes! Tala feels sad. (pause) Grabbing is not kind.
s3: Who will help Bunso? (pause) Then Nanay says, Bunso, use the magic word. (pause) Bunso gives the book back. (pause) He asks, May I please borrow your book?
s4: Bunso asked nicely. What will Tala say? (pause) Last, Tala smiles. (pause) Yes, you may! (pause) Bunso says, Thank you, Tala! (pause) Kind words make everyone happy.
story-check: That is the end of the story. Let us think. (pause) Let us think about the story.
story-check-q1: Which is the kind way to ask?
story-check-q1-yes: Yes! May I please borrow your book? (pause) That is kind.
story-check-q2: What did Bunso say at the end?
story-check-q2-yes: Yes! Bunso said, thank you! (pause) We say thank you when someone shares.
pass: Bunso asked for a book. What will you ask for? (pause) Now you ask! (pause) What do you need at the table? (pause) Tap one. Then say it with me.
talk: Nanay passes the glass. What do you say? (pause) When someone helps you, say thank you. (pause) Say: Thank you, Nanay! (pause) Now say it to someone at home!
verse: We ask people nicely. We can ask God too! (pause) Our Bible verse is, (pause) Present your requests to God with thanksgiving. (pause) We ask God nicely. (pause) And we say thank you to God!
verse-verse: Present your requests to God (pause) with thanksgiving. (pause) Philippians four, verse six.
done: What a kind day! (pause) Hooray! (pause) You named things at home. (pause) You asked with please. (pause) And you said thank you. (pause) Tomorrow, we look for things that are the same and different!
fx-try-2: Look again. You can do it!
fx-cheer-1: Hi! You are doing so well!
fx-cheer-2: I am happy to learn with you!
fx-still-1: Good listening! Simon did not say it.
fx-oops-1: Oops! Simon did not say it. Stay still next time!
fx-doit-1: Simon said it! Let us do it!
